summary: DialogContent preventDefaults onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside after the props spread and Omits both from its public props, guarded by a behavioural real-primitive oracle proven to invert against master; Esc and X untouched; sr-only label now pt-BR Fechar.
red_confirmed: Structural half, before implementation: 4 of 5 failed as predicted (onPointerDownOutside and onInteractOutside both 'expected undefined to be function'; 'expected TituloClose to contain Fechar'; and the override test 'expected spy to be called 1 times, but got 0 times'). Behavioural half, proven by inversion during remediation: with master's unguarded dialog.tsx copied over the guarded one, both new outside-pointerdown tests failed with 'expected spy to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times' and a recorded 1st call of [false], i.e. the unguarded dialog really did dismiss; Esc and X stayed green throughout. Guarded version restored and confirmed byte-identical to the committed file before re-running the gates.
tests_changed: none (no pre-existing test touched; git diff master..HEAD over test paths is 288 insertions, 0 deletions across the two new files)
remediation: Gate 2 attempt 1 FAIL was oracle-only, so apps/web/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx and alert-dialog.tsx were left byte-identical to the first commit (verified: they show no diff against HEAD when re-staged). Three changes. (1) Deleted the false paragraph in dialog-outside-close.test.tsx that claimed outside-click dismissal 'provably does not fire inside happy-dom' and that a DOM-driven test 'could never go Red'. Replaced with an honest framing: this file is the structural complement, it is coupled to Radix prop names, and the behavioural file is what catches an upstream rename. (2) Added two behavioural tests to dialog-close-affordances.test.tsx under a new describe 'dialogs never close on an outside pointer down', driving the real @radix-ui/react-dialog with no vi.mock: one dispatches new Event('pointerdown', {bubbles:true}) on a sibling button appended to document.body, the other dispatches the full button-0 MouseEvent pointerdown/mousedown/mouseup/click sequence; both settle a macrotask after dispatching (so a deferred dismissal has a chance to land rather than passing for the wrong reason) and assert onOpenChange was never called and [role=dialog] is still in document.body. The file comment now records the real subtlety: DialogContentImpl passes deferPointerDownOutside:true and Radix defers only when event.button===0, so a lone button-0 MouseEvent probe merely parks the dismissal on a click that never comes, which is why it looks inert. (3) Corrected the plan file in four places: the 'Test harness reality' section now carries an explicit CORRECTED block disowning the false finding and naming the two dispatch forms that do dismiss, File 1 is retitled 'structural complement' and File 2 'the real Red', the risk bullet 'The oracle could be vacuous' is rewritten as 'The oracle could be structural rather than behavioural', and the plan's non-compiling {...(x as never)} cast form is flagged with the TS2698 error and the working object-typed replacement. Inversion was proven by cp-ing git show master:apps/web/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx over the guarded file, running the affordances suite (2 failed / 2 passed), then restoring from the scratchpad backup and confirming a clean git diff against HEAD; I watched the failure myself before shipping. Amended into the single existing commit; web tests went 150 to 152.
notes: One deviation from the plan's literal text, forced by tsc and now recorded in the plan: the plan's test-5 spread form {...({ onPointerDownOutside: spy } as never)} fails type-check with TS2698 'Spread types may only be created from object types'. Replaced with {...(extraProps as unknown as React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogContent>)}, same bypass-the-type intent, identical assertions. The two behavioural tests live in dialog-close-affordances.test.tsx rather than a new fifth file, both to respect the instruction to stage only the plan's four source paths and because that file is the one without a vi.mock of the Radix primitive; its top comment and describe blocks make the wider scope explicit. Verify's noted minor gap is still open and deliberately so: nothing asserts the type-level Omit directly (no @ts-expect-error probe), so the compile-time half rests on pnpm run type-check over existing call sites. Out of scope but noticed: apps/web/src/components/ui/__tests__/ already existed as an empty untracked directory before this slice; and apps/web/src/components/ui/*.tsx use double quotes while prettier.config.js sets singleQuote true, so the shadcn primitives are not prettier-normalized, left as is to keep the diff minimal.
